name: ModelVariant459_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant459_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the config record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets three slot parts and packs five texture images before setting up three webs, sixteen glows, a sheet, the globe (nine rows of seventeen points at work + 0xFF8), the nine-by-nine screen grid and five curtains, otherwise it runs one frame (sheet, spiral, screen grid, curtains and globe from the config's start, second and fade frames) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2 after the fade; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in the fourteen model-712 stage-9/10 images except the Spanish two, whose entry is still generated assembly; the French header-476/626 images build it from the same source with palette x 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
